mapper.sql: SELECT c.code, cat.code AS category_code, c.type, c.title, c.summary, TO_CHAR(c.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS updated_at
mapper.select: FROM content c JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id JOIN topic t ON t.id = cat.topic_id WHERE c.status = 'published' AND cat.code = #{categoryCode} AND cat.enabled = TRUE AND t.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY c.published_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content c JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id JOIN topic t ON t.id = cat.topic_id WHERE c.status = 'published' AND cat.code = #{categoryCode} AND cat.enabled = TRUE AND t.enabled = TRUE
FROM content c JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id WHERE c.status = 'published' ORDER BY c.published_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content c WHERE c.status = 'published'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) AS total_views, COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) AS total_likes FROM content WHERE status = 'published'
FROM content c JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id WHERE c.status = 'published' AND c.recommended = TRUE ORDER BY c.published_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content c WHERE c.status = 'published' AND c.recommended = TRUE

FROM content c JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id WHERE c.status = 'published' AND ( c.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.summary ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM unnest(c.tags) AS tag WHERE tag ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY c.published_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content c WHERE c.status = 'published' AND ( c.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.summary ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM unnest(c.tags) AS tag WHERE tag ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )

SELECT c.code, cat.code AS category_code, t.code AS topic_code, c.type, c.title, c.summary, c.body, c.tags, c.source, c.like_count, c.view_count, FALSE AS liked, TO_CHAR(c.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS published_at, TO_CHAR(c.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS updated_at FROM content c JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id JOIN topic t ON t.id = cat.topic_id WHERE c.code = #{contentCode} AND c.status = 'published' AND cat.enabled = TRUE AND t.enabled = TRUE

SELECT c.code, cat.code AS category_code, t.code AS topic_code, c.type, c.title, c.summary, c.body, c.tags, c.source, c.like_count, c.view_count, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_like cl WHERE cl.content_id = c.id AND cl.visitor_id = #{visitorId} ) AS liked, TO_CHAR(c.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS published_at, TO_CHAR(c.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS updated_at FROM content c JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id JOIN topic t ON t.id = cat.topic_id WHERE c.code = #{contentCode} AND c.status = 'published' AND cat.enabled = TRUE AND t.enabled = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE content SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE code = #{contentCode} AND status = 'published'

where.if: AND (c.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.summary ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT c.code, cat.code AS category_code, c.type, c.title, c.status, c.version, TO_CHAR(c.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS updated_at FROM content c JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content c JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id

SELECT c.code, cat.code AS category_code, c.type, c.title, c.summary, c.body, c.tags, c.source, c.status, c.recommended, c.version, TO_CHAR(c.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS published_at, TO_CHAR(c.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS updated_at FROM content c JOIN category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id WHERE c.code = #{contentCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content (code, category_id, type, title, summary, body, tags, source, status, version) VALUES (#{code}, (SELECT id FROM category WHERE code = #{categoryCode}), #{type}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{body}, #{tags,jdbcType=ARRAY,typeHandler=com.aiguide.common.typehandler.StringArrayTypeHandler}, #{source}, 'draft', 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE content SET category_id = (SELECT id FROM category WHERE code = #{categoryCode}), type = #{type}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, body = #{body}, tags = #{tags,jdbcType=ARRAY,typeHandler=com.aiguide.common.typehandler.StringArrayTypeHandler}, source = #{source}, recommended = #{recommended}, version = version + 1 WHERE code = #{contentCode} AND version = #{version}
